clues.kinetics: Clearance decreases over time, by a mean maximal 17% from baseline, which is not considered clinically relevant. Exposure rises in proportion to dose from 1 mg/kg to 20 mg/kg.
clues.substance: A sterile, preservative-free solution in single-dose vials at a pH of 5.8, with a calculated molecular mass of 145 kDa.
clues.product: Approved under a BLA, with 60 mg/mL vials in two sizes. Dosed every 2, 3 or 4 weeks.
clues.safety: No boxed warning, and no contraindications. Fatigue or asthenia and nausea are among the most common reactions, at 20% or more.
clues.indication: Non-small cell lung cancer, as adjuvant treatment after resection of stage II to IIIA disease and as first-line treatment of selected metastatic disease, plus other uses.
clues.mechanism: Binds PD-L1 and blocks its interaction with PD-1 and B7.1 on T cells and antigen-presenting cells, releasing T-cell activity. It does not induce antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity.

tell: An Fc-engineered IgG1 PD-L1 antibody that does not induce antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity.
